Neutrino decoupling at 1-2 MeV; T_nu/T_gamma -> (4/11)^(1/3) after e+e- annihilation; g_* = 10.75 -> 3.36
Gamma(chi2 -> chi1 nu nubar) = G_F^2 delta^5/(20 pi^3) (Higgsino); dark photon Gamma = 3 G_eff^2 delta^5/(120 pi^3), G_eff = g_D eps tan(theta_W) g/(4 cos(theta_W) m_Z^2)
Gamma(chi2 -> chi1 gamma) = mu_12^2 delta^3/pi with mu_12 ~ kappa (alpha_2/2pi) e/(2 mu), kappa = 0.1-3

failed_or_abandoned: First t(z) table (linear-z quad to infinity) lost accuracy above z ~ 5e6 and gave a 12.6 Gyr age; replaced by a log-variable integral to z = 1e6 plus the analytic radiation-era t = 1/(2H), with T(t) at t < 1e4 s from inverting H_early(T).
Fermi-Dirac statistics with Pauli blocking for the bath not implemented (MB keeps detailed balance exact; 3% effect on the rates).
Hadronic channels between 1 and 150 MeV and the A' propagator at E >~ m_A' neglected (irrelevant for T_* <= 27 MeV, m_A' >= 0.3 GeV).
A Slatyer-Wu principal-component CMB likelihood was not attempted (no CLASS/HyRec offline); a single energy-per-baryon criterion is used and flagged.
Two figure-label iterations to remove collisions (Higgsino annotation; dark-photon marker labels).
